text:
Noah Kim: Starting a quick thread to capture the launch assets we need for the enterprise deploy brief. Target: security/SRE audiences + a gated one-pager AEs can send. Main asks: short benchmark callout, clear SLA language, inbound routing for demos, and an AE-ready email.
Elena Ruiz: I'll draft the gated one-pager copy. Should be two-column: left side TL;DR + comparison bullets, right side methodology + CTA. Tone: straightforward, data-first.
Priyanka Shah: From demand ops: we need the HubSpot routing rules and the exact form fields so mapping goes in cleanly. Also request a hidden asset_id field for tracking.
Chris O'Malley: Product confirms recommended SLA phrasing: Hosted -> "Standard availability (typical 99.5%); quick evaluation." Dedicated -> "Reserved capacity with enterprise SLA (target 99.9% uptime)." Private -> "Customer-managed availability; Redwood provides install and ops support." Keep it non-binding but clear.
Noah Kim: Benchmark callout: avoid absolute promises. Proposed hero line: "Dedicated: most predictable P95; Private: lowest unit cost when fully amortized; Hosted: fastest to evaluate." Engineers will supply P95 bands to visualize.
Elena Ruiz: For the one-pager sections: 1) TL;DR (3 bullets) 2) Quick comparison (privacy, SLA, cost, time-to-live) 3) Migration playbook (eval -> pilot -> rollout) 4) What to expect after demo (timeline) 5) Appendix: methodology + eval command.
Priyanka Shah: Form fields proposal for gated download: 
- email
- full_name
- company
- title
- company_size
- region
- deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private)
- compliance_requirements (multi-select: SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP, HIPAA, Other)
- desired_sla
- accept_contact (checkbox)
Plus hidden: asset_id=deploy_brief_enterprise_2823 and utm params capture.
Chris O'Malley: Routing pseudo-rule for HubSpot to include in ops doc: 
```
if form.deployment_interest == "private" or form.compliance_requirements contains "FedRAMP" or form.company_size > 1000:
  assign -> "Enterprise-AE"
  notify -> "Solutions-Eng"
elif form.deployment_interest == "dedicated" and form.company_size >= 100:
  assign -> "Mid-Market-AE"
else:
  assign -> "SDR-Nurture"
end
```
Noah Kim: Good. We should also add an auto-task for SE if compliance flag present: add_task("SE: compliance review within 2 biz days").
Elena Ruiz: Benchmarks: engineering provided ranges for the hero chart -- P95 latency: Hosted ~90-170ms, Dedicated ~45-85ms, Private ~85-150ms. Typical avg tokens in our test: 138. We'll include a small methodology note: "chat-like distribution, 50-300 tokens, reproducibility script in appendix."
Priyanka Shah: Can we include a short demo triage flow in the brief: after request -> 1 business day triage -> 2-3 day sizing + pilot proposal -> pilot run (1-2 weeks) -> rollout. Helps set expectations.
Chris O'Malley: Add the reproducibility snippet for appendix: 
```
./evaluate --model redwood-dedicated-v2 --workload chat --seq-min 50 --seq-max 300 --samples 100000 --capture p50 p95 cost_per_million
```
Noah Kim: AE email snippet (paste-ready): 
"Hi <Name>,

Attached is a short brief comparing Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment options. It highlights typical SLA commitments, a quick benchmark summary, and a recommended pilot checklist. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min tech review to scope compliance and sizing.

Best,
<AE name>"
Elena Ruiz: I'll produce two deliverables: printable PDF one-pager for AEs and a gated HTML brief for lead capture. Copy draft by EOD tomorrow; design mock by day-after.
Priyanka Shah: I'll prepare the HubSpot form mapping and the workflow code block so engineering and ops can implement. Also will add the hidden fields and UTM captures.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: upload copy to /marketing-assets/enterprise/ by 2823462000. Review meeting set for 2823465600.
Noah Kim: Action items recap: Elena -> copy + AE email + downloadable PDF draft. Chris -> confirm final P95 bands and csv by morning. Priyanka -> HubSpot form mapping + pseudo-workflow. We'll aim to have the gated page live 3 days after copy sign-off. Keep messaging transparent to reduce follow-up churn.
Chris O'Malley: Will upload CSV and PNG chart to the doc by 2823460000.
Elena Ruiz: Thanks team 44d. I'll tag the draft here when ready for review.
Priyanka Shah: All good. I'll also create the SFDC hidden field mapping so AEs see source context in inbound leads.
Noah Kim: Thanks everyone; loop back after the review meeting.
OpsBot: Checklist created: ensure form privacy checkbox present, hidden asset_id included, and AE email snippet embedded in the gated thank-you page.
